YouTube also uses playlists to identify special collections of videos for a channel, such as: * uploaded videos * favorite videos * positively rated (liked) videos * watch history * watch later To be more specific, these lists are associated with a channel, which is a collection of a person, group, or company's videos, playlists, and other YouTube information. You can retrieve the playlist IDs for each of these lists from the [`channel resource`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/channels) for a given channel. You can then use the [`playlistItems.list`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/list) method to retrieve any of those lists. You can also add or remove items from those lists by calling the [`playlistItems.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/insert) and [`playlistItems.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/delete) methods.

You can retrieve the playlist IDs for each of these lists from the [`channel resource`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/channels) for a given channel. You can then use the [`playlistItems.list`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/list) method to retrieve any of those lists. You can also add or remove items from those lists by calling the [`playlistItems.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/insert) and [`playlistItems.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/delete) methods. memberMilestoneChatDetails.description: Details about the Member Milestone Chat event, this is only set if the type is `memberMilestoneChatEvent`.

publishedAt.description: The date and time when the message was orignally published.

hasDisplayContent.description: Whether the message has display content that should be displayed to users.

displayMessage.description: Contains a string that can be displayed to the user. If this field is not present the message is silent, at the moment only messages of type TOMBSTONE and CHAT_ENDED_EVENT are silent.

newSponsorDetails.description: Details about the New Member Announcement event, this is only set if the type is `newSponsorEvent`. The term "member" replaces "sponsor".

giftMembershipReceivedDetails.description: Details about the Gift Membership Received event, this is only set if the type is `giftMembershipReceivedEvent`.

pollDetails.description: Details about the poll event, this is only set if the type is `pollEvent`.

type.description: The type of message, this will always be present, it determines the contents of the message as well as which fields will be present.

membershipGiftingDetails.description: Details about the Membership Gifting event, this is only set if the type is `membershipGiftingEvent`.

superChatDetails.description: Details about the Super Chat event, this is only set if the type is `superChatEvent`.

giftDetails.description: Details about the gift event, this is only set if the type is `giftEvent`.

superStickerDetails.description: Details about the Super Sticker event, this is only set if the type is `superStickerEvent`.

fanFundingEventDetails.description: Details about the funding event, this is only set if the type is `fanFundingEvent`.

snippet.description: The snippet object contains basic details about the channel, such as its title, description, and thumbnail images.

watchLater.description: The ID of the playlist that contains the channel"s watch later playlist. uploads.description: The ID of the playlist that contains the channel"s uploaded videos. Use the [`videos.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/videos/insert) method to upload new videos and the [`videos.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/videos/delete) method to delete previously uploaded videos.

watchHistory.description: The ID of the playlist that contains the channel"s watch history. Use the [`playlistItems.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/insert) and [`playlistItems.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/delete) to add or remove items from that list.

likes.description: The ID of the playlist that contains the channel"s liked videos. Use the [`playlistItems.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/insert) and [`playlistItems.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/delete) to add or remove items from that list.

favorites.description: The ID of the playlist that contains the channel"s favorite videos. Use the [`playlistItems.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/insert) and [`playlistItems.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/delete) to add or remove items from that list.
